autosaveIdleSeconds.title: Autosave after idle (seconds)
autosaveIdleSeconds.description: A file tab saves this long after you stop typing; micro autosaves this often too. 0 turns idle autosave off (Ctrl+S still saves). Empty: 3, or the micro autosave you had set before. When Claude changed the file meanwhile, nothing is overwritten.

autosaveOnBlur.title: Autosave on focus loss
autosaveOnBlur.description: A file tab saves when you leave it (another tab, another window).

colorscheme.title: Colour scheme
colorscheme.description: For Open in micro: a micro colorscheme name (e.g. dracula-tc, gruvbox-tc, solarized-tc, default); empty uses your micro settings.

microPath.title: micro command
microPath.description: For Open in micro: the micro binary: a name looked up on your login-shell PATH, or an absolute path.

cli.name: edit
cli.summary: Edit a file of this project in micro, in an overlay
